verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud. The evidence shows only OpenAI-compatible APIs and model hosting, which are developer building blocks for constructing an insights feature. There is no evidence of an in-product feature that analyzes the user's own data (for example usage or account data) and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
